payday_convention: Monthly 15th cash paydate. The final month earns contractual monthly salary times inclusive employment days divided by actual calendar days; earned final wages remain payable on the 15th even after retirement. Future employer settlement dates and bonus eligibility are planning assumptions.

income_tax_withholding.note: D-076 records Steven's actual payroll withholding as 10% of salary and bonuses. This is cash withheld from pay, not a final annual income-tax assessment.

voluntary_labor_pension.note: Keep the existing 6% voluntary contribution. It reduces spendable cash before retirement and remains locked until age 60; it is not added to the pre-retirement investable-cash contribution.

annual_salary_increase.frequency: every March 1; bonus uses salary on payment date

planned_living_costs.proration_method: Display only: annual August-2026 living budget TWD750000 includes all taxes and routine car repairs; home/appliance TWD50000 annual average is additional. Shown payroll taxes consume the living envelope; other annual investment/settlement taxes are handled by the full monthly model. The model never deducts this displayed surplus/budget again.

revalidation.reason: The 116 (2027) NHI premium schedule and labor-pension wage brackets were not officially published as of 2026-08-27. Recalculate the ledger if either changes; the 2027 ordinary labor-insurance rate is set from the existing statutory step schedule.

recurrence_note: Explicit paydates override projected recurring months. Future bonus payment months are planning assumptions, not an employer calendar. Do not infer an unearned termination-month salary or a guaranteed payment from a candidate date.

final_month_convention.labor_and_employment_insurance_and_self_: partial month uses insured days / 30; full month uses 1 regardless of month length
final_month_convention.employer_nhi: full monthly premium only if still employed on the last day of the month; otherwise transferred coverage is within the normal living budget
final_month_convention.bonus: contractual salary on payment date, only if still employed on that date; employer confirmation required
